ideas.pitch: A localized transportation and safety coordination platform for Penn State students navigating off-campus housing and late-night study sessions, optimizing campus loop and walking routes using real-time density metrics.
ideas.title: StateCollab Campus Transit & Safety Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a problem the judges feel themselves by solving the exact campus safety and transportation hurdles faced daily by students at University Park.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed proctoring and study session analysis tool that evaluates study habits and provides local privacy-first feedback without cloud telemetry leaks.
ideas.title: Nittany AI Academic Integrity & Proctoring Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with institutional themes around academic AI governance and safety that academic evaluators at University Park prioritize.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered platform connecting State College small businesses with student consumer co-ops to streamline local inventory purchasing and student discounts.
ideas.title: HappyValley Local Merchant Matcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Delivers clear measurable impact with concrete economic benefits for local businesses around the campus corridor.

ideas.pitch: An automated campus resource usage dashboard that aggregates dining hall food waste metrics and dorm energy draw to gamify sustainability efforts across residence halls.
ideas.title: PennState Sustainability Carbon Footprint Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into strong university sustainability goals, giving judges a quantifiable metric for environmental impact.

ideas.pitch: An automated matching service that pairs Penn State alumni working in tech and finance with current students for rapid resume reviews and mock interviews based on calendar availability.
ideas.title: Alumni Network Mentorship Dispatcher
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a real pain point that student judges and career-focused attendees experience firsthand during recruiting season.
